text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Mom's milk tea is simply exquisite. Dad's 
face always looks so peaceful sipping 
it... Our home is truly overflowing with 
love—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(I have no intention of socializing with 
anyone on this account, but... I am 
delighted to see our household's splendor 
made known.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Heh, since you're offering... I have 
plenty I could talk about.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(It seems Orfe liked the canelés I baked. 
She didn't say a word, but I can tell. The 
bond of family truly is one of a kind...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"This is also Uma-Art. Ah, still not 
enough..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey got completely hooked on 
social media and ended up slacking off on 
her training.
